gates.rule: every CR has a kind and a source from the lists, a request in the client's own words, and lane null|ui|full
a CR with source finding names an existing DEF
a display CR names at least one ENT.attribute and every one exists on its entity
an open CR older than 14 days that still has no impact
every artifact at approved or beyond that an open CR freezes, with the CR and its lane
a closed CR records who signed and the evidence, and nothing it touched is still draft
